import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    run_lengths = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        start = i
        ch = s[i]
        while i < n and s[i] == ch:
            i += 1
        run_lengths.append(i - start)
    count = 0
    for length in run_lengths:
        if length % 2 == 0:
            count += 1
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
